POSH Inquiry Navigator

Purchase and licence terms

Live online purchases are currently closed.

These terms describe the digital Inquiry Essential, Professional and Advanced licences offered by The Cosmic Energizers when online sales open. Your order summary will identify your plan, included features, seat count, term, taxes and total payable. If you buy for an organisation, you must be authorised to place the order.

One licence per proceeding

Each order covers one authorised proceeding. The buyer counts as one seat and can assign remaining seats to confirmed Navigator accounts within the plan limit. Seats may be reassigned during the editing term. A seat does not determine Committee composition, membership or quorum. Use individual credentials and keep account access within your authorised team.

Access periods

Editing begins when Navigator verifies the captured payment and activates the plan. Essential includes six months and two seats, Professional nine months and five seats, and Advanced twelve months and eight seats. Each includes a further three calendar months of read-only access for reviewing a locally saved recovery file. Editing, draft generation and seat changes end when the editing period ends. Your previously downloaded files remain on your device. There is no automatic renewal.

Permitted use

You may prepare drafts for the licensed proceeding and share completed documents with authorised recipients. You may not resell the software or publicly redistribute its template library. The Committee decides the applicable procedure, evidentiary assessment, findings and recommendations. Drafts do not serve notices, certify compliance or alter statutory timelines.

Questions and remedies

Voluntary refunds are unavailable once the correct plan is delivered and activated as described. Finishing the inquiry or no longer needing access does not qualify for a voluntary refund.

See our digital delivery policy and cancellation and refund policy. These terms are governed by applicable Indian law and preserve mandatory rights and remedies.
